problem_statement: memmem() in libs/libc/string/lib_memmem.c has an off-by-one error: the loop condition uses `i < haystacklen - needlelen` instead of `i <= haystacklen - needlelen`, causing it to miss the last valid match position. Additionally, zero-length needle handling is missing. Apps PR #2327 adds libc_memmem.c to ostest which calls ASSERT() to verify memmem() returns correct pointers. On base commit, the off-by-one causes memmem("hello",5,"lo",2) to return NULL instead of haystack+3, firing the ASSERT and aborting ostest.
